content.text:
Daily synchronization already captures changed declarations and merges them into a complete retained snapshot. The expensive step is downstream: when content changes, it cleans and resolves the full snapshot before publishing.

The database projection lacks complete source records, so it is not a safe baseline for incremental processing. The sealed capture manifest retains that evidence. A delta writer would also need to replace every funding row for corrected declarations, preserve funders and aliases referenced by untouched rows, and prune aliases only after checking all surviving funding entries.
